```python
def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(case["required_symbols"])
    
    # Build node lookup and children map
    node_map = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    children = {n["id"]: [] for n in nodes}
    for n in nodes:
        if n["parent"] is not None:
            children[n["parent"]].append(n["id"])
    
    # Validate required fields
    for n in nodes:
        for field in ["id", "parent", "symbol", "depth", "removable", "utility"]:
            if field not in n:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing field {field} in node {n.get('id', '?')}")
    
    # Sort nodes: deepest first, then by node ID (lexicographic) as tie-break
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    
    # Track retained set
    retained = set(n["id"] for n in nodes)
    removed_order = []
    
    for n in sorted_nodes:
        nid = n["id"]
        
        # Skip if not removable
        if not n["removable"]:
            continue
        
        # Skip root (parent is null/None) - but root is also removable=false typically
        if n["parent"] is None:
            continue
        
        # Check: has retained children?
        if any(child in retained for child in children[nid]):
            continue
        
        # Check: if we remove this node, do all required symbols remain represented?
        # Tentatively remove
        retained.remove(nid)
        symbols_remaining = set(node_map[rid]["symbol"] for rid in retained)
        if required_symbols.issubset(symbols_remaining):
            # Keep removed
            removed_order.append(nid)
        else:
            # Put back
            retained.add(nid)
    
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removed_order,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted
    }
```
